title: Ultrasound-based radiomics for early predicting response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with breast cancer: a systematic review with meta-analysis
methodological_quality: RQS and QUADAS-2 used; authors report limited data and low quality of eligible studies; prospective studies apparently had more optimal sensitivity than retrospective studies.
summary: Eight studies were eligible (search through 1 January 2023). Pooled sensitivity was 0.87 (95% CI 0.81–0.92) and specificity 0.78 (95% CI 0.72–0.83); mean RQS was 12.88/36 (35.8%). The authors conclude that limited data and low study quality warrant larger multicenter prospective studies with rigorous methods.
